expo.name: Wheaty
expo.description: AI-powered wheat farming assistant for crop diagnosis, farm planning, voice questions, mapped farm profiles, and farm memory.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Wheaty uses the camera to capture crop images for disease diagnosis.
